Mesh Relay

Releases of Mesh Relay, an Android app that shows SNR and RSSI per relay node for a Meshtastic mesh. Source: https://github.com/cerocoder/mesh-relay-android

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://cerocoder.github.io/mesh-relay-fdroid-repo/repo
